findings.mechanism: Swallowed exception and use of jwt.decode without verification allows invalid or malicious tokens to be accepted, turning an authentication failure into a successful response. Cites 03-errors-as-interface.
findings.remediation: Replace jwt.decode with jwt.verify using the SECRET, and propagate verification errors instead of returning null silently.
findings.arithmetic: jwt.decode never throws and does not verify signature, so any crafted token yields a Claims object; therefore under condition 'invalid JWT signature', the service will return an HTTP 2xx status, indicating success.
